verdict.rationale: Devin autonomously implements features and bug fixes and integrates with PR workflows: 'Devin Review provides automated first-pass reviews on pull requests' and 'Auto-Fix... iterates on CI failures — creating a closed loop where PRs iterate toward merge-ready quality' implies it creates and manages PRs as part of its normal workflow, and docs-1 confirms it implements features/fixes bugs end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the granular steps (staging changes, writing commit messages, branch creation) and independent hands-on confirmation of PR-opening mechanics.
